scope: Fresh matched local screen comparing native C749 and three continuation arms with identical frozen actor/decoding and scoring.
order: Listed map order, listed identical engine/policy seeds, then exact frozen roster order. One attempt per identity.
withheld_confirmation_policy: Two fresh families and two paired seeds each. Only an approved qualified nominee and C749 may run in a new authorized phase. Confirm no regression in exit/survival/key/unlock per family and meaningful gain on both families.

promotion_gate.legal: Ten completed legal episodes per model, paired with C749; zero invalid actions or timeouts.
promotion_gate.preserve: Match or exceed C749 exits, survivals, collected keys and verified unlocks on every family.
promotion_gate.material_outcome: On two independent families improve exits, keys, unlocks, player-attributed damage, or coverage with a lower blocked-move fraction. At least one gain family must show a gain on both predeclared seeds. Fewer attacks or lower bias alone are diagnostic.
promotion_gate.decision: If the gate fails, retain C749. A qualifying variant also requires untouched confirmation, exact official validator and explicit approval for any replacement.
